import numpy as np

def hp_filter(y, lamb=100):
    n = len(y)
    D = np.zeros((n-2, n))
    for i in range(n-2):
        D[i, i] = 1
        D[i, i+1] = -2
        D[i, i+2] = 1
    
    I = np.eye(n)
    tau = np.linalg.solve(I + lamb * D.T @ D, y)
    return tau

receipts = np.array([
    2161728, 2302495, 2449092, 2773979, 3020847,
    3248722, 3266689, 3314893, 3328745, 3462195,
    3419955, 4045980, 4896119, 4439283, 4918737
])

outlays = np.array([
    3455931, 3598086, 3538447, 3454254, 3504199,
    3687623, 3854101, 3980720, 4107741, 4446583,
    6551871, 6818159, 6271508, 6134433, 6751553
])

years = list(range(2010, 2025))

trend_receipts = hp_filter(receipts, lamb=100)
trend_outlays = hp_filter(outlays, lamb=100)

structural_balance = trend_receipts - trend_outlays
actual_balance = receipts - outlays

fy2024_idx = years.index(2024)

actual_2024 = actual_balance[fy2024_idx]
structural_2024 = structural_balance[fy2024_idx]
gap = abs(actual_2024 - structural_2024)

print(f"Actual balance FY 2024: {round(actual_2024)}")
print(f"Structural balance FY 2024: {round(structural_2024)}")
print(f"Gap: {round(gap)}")

with open('/app/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"[{round(actual_2024)}, {round(structural_2024)}, {round(gap)}]")
